name: SureMembers Core
author: Brainstorm Force

sections.description:
SureMembers Core is the free version of SureMembers, an integration based content restriction solution.

Full features are coming soon. Stay tuned for upcoming updates!
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly or upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/suremembers-core directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How can I report a security bug?

We take plugin security extremely seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it in a safe and responsible manner.
You can report the issue through our Bug Bounty Program. We collaborate with Patchstack to provide opportunities for researchers to report vulnerabilities. The Patchstack team will help validate, triage, and handle any reported security issues.
